reason: I'd download it free if a friend sent it and try the basil pork, but 3 questions a day is already more than I'd ever ask, so paying 99 baht a month just for unlimited questions makes no sense. With only two dishes I'd probably delete it after a week or two.
objection: It's another monthly subscription for something the free version already covers, and two dishes I can learn from YouTube or TikTok for free. I already know how to make a pork omelet.
would_change_my_mind: If the membership unlocked a lot more everyday dishes, like a new one every week, instead of just more questions.
